claims.harm: A transaction that exhausted send attempts without being echoed cannot be sent again because Add() only restarts resolved transactions but GetStale() skips it
claims.quote: A tx that used all its send attempts, but never came back from the network, can no longer be sent again. Now `Add()` can only restarts a tx that is resolved. But `GetStale()` skips such a tx, so nothing marks it resolved.

claims.author: frankomosh
claims.quote:
If another peer sends us the same tx later, this line replaces the saved peer and time. So `received_by_us` may not show the first peer that sent it back.

Should we keep the first one?
claims.request: Keep the first peer and time rather than overwriting received_by_us when another peer sends the same transaction later
